title: ARPI Power BI Desktop validation result
description: The evidence file scripts/validate_powerbi_model.ps1 writes after connecting to a running Power BI Desktop model, refreshing it, and comparing every governed measure against powerbi/validation/sql_baseline.json. scripts/check_desktop_validation_freshness.py reads it in CI. A result is only believable if model_source_hash still matches the current TMDL source: a model that was validated and then edited has no valid evidence, and CI reports that state as STALE rather than as passed.

validated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the validation ran. Null when it has never run.

model_source_hash.description: SHA-256 over every file under ARPI_Performance_Intelligence.SemanticModel/definition/ plus definition.pbism, computed by scripts/check_desktop_validation_freshness.py --print-hash. Null when validation has never run.

power_bi_desktop_version.description: Product version of the Power BI Desktop instance that was validated.

compatibility_level.description: Tabular compatibility level reported by the running model.

row_counts.description: Rows loaded per imported table, compared against model_expectations.json.

passed_checks.description: Identifier of every check that passed, for example 'sql-to-dax:store-GSA-001:KPI-GRS-006'.

sql_to_dax_differences.description: Every measure whose DAX value differed from the SQL baseline beyond tolerance. Empty is the only acceptable state for a passed result.

overall_result.description: 'pending' means Power BI Desktop has never opened this model. It is not a pass, and CI must never render it as one.
